description: Peer messages: agent.prompt to a terminal whose integration takes messages (agent.report protocol 1) queues out of band; agent.inbox takes them (held per connection, acked, started), agent.wait waits while one is queued and for the turn it started, agent.read final is unavailable meanwhile; a script's message (from, user attribution, next-turn); addresses: name@board, a renamed terminal's alias until another terminal takes the name, the caller's board first, ambiguity and unknown boards; release bounces what is queued (back to a sending terminal that takes messages as a message from easl, a script's into board.history as kind message); a typed next-turn into a working terminal is a conflict.
recordedOn: easl peer/messages (Peer messages, review fixes), dev instance
